gap: No result ChatGPT got states today's (2026-11-15) maker-store and Amazon prices for the full 1 kWh field: the BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 is in stock at $499 on BLUETTI US (1,800 W, 1,000 W solar, 25 lb), the DJI Power 1000 V2 is $399.98 on Amazon, the EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic is $459 on EcoFlow US and the Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 is $529.99 on Amazon.
standout_why: I compared against backup-power.org (cited), thepowerstationguide.com (cited) and ridgewatt.com/compare (cited). backup-power.org prices the Elite 100 V2 only as 'just under $500' and says it was out of stock. It has no DJI and no DELTA 3 Classic, and gives the Anker C1000 Gen 2 as $599.99 and sold out. thepowerstationguide.com gives no prices at all, only Amazon 'Check Price' buttons. ridgewatt lists only three models: Jackery at $559, Anker at $700 and DELTA 3 Plus with no price. None of them has the DJI Power 1000 V2 at $399.98, the DELTA 3 Classic at $459 or the Elite 100 V2 in stock at $499. enoughwatts.com (cited in two chats) could not be opened because of a TLS certificate error, so I could not check it.
decides: For 'best 1000 watt' (read as about 1 kWh with full-size output), the BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 at $499 ($0.49/Wh) has the most going for it at today's prices. BLUETTI's store lists 1,800 W AC, 1,000 W solar, 25 lb and 10 ms UPS. That beats the Anker C1000 Gen 2 at $529.99 (600 W solar per backup-power.org) and the EcoFlow DELTA 3 at $579. The cheapest 1 kWh unit is the DJI Power 1000 V2 at $399.98 ($0.39/Wh, 2,600 W per thepowerstationguide), which tops output, but thepowerstationguide lists it at 31.3 lb, about 6 lb more than the Elite 100 V2. ChatGPT's Elite 100 Mini costs $429 but only puts out 700 W, so it fails the '1000 watt' reading. Dealectric already lists the Elite 100 V2 (bluetti-elite-100-v2, awin), so the confirmed pick is one we can link.
